chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'Seize the opportunity for supplication at four [times]: during the recitation of the Quran, and during the Adhan, and during the descent of rain, and during the meeting of the two rows [of armies] for martyrdom.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (referring to Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What are the four best times for making supplication according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the chain of al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the spiritual potency of these four moments, reflecting the Shia tradition of linking cosmic signs and ritual acts with divine responsiveness. The inclusion of 'meeting of the two armies' highlights the eschatological and transitional nature of battle, while the other three moments connect personal devotion (Quran, Adhan) with natural blessings (rain).

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said: ‘

Seize (the opportunity for) the supplication during four (timings) – during recitation of the Quran, and during the (recitation of) the Azaan, and during the descent of the rain, and during the meeting of the two rows (of armies), for the martyrdom’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) has said, ‘Use the opportunity for praying and pleading before Allah for help, on four occasions: at the time of reading the Holy Quran, at the time of Adhan (call for prayer) at the time it rains and at the time of the meeting of two armies (of which one sides is) for martyrdom.”’
